meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把实验室的样本、库存和实验记录自动同步到 Benchling,省去手动录入。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管数据,想把重复录入交给脚本。
copy.tagline_en: Sync lab samples and experiment records into Benchling automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab runs on Benchling and you want to automate manual data entry.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 benchling-sdk 和 v2 API 操作 Benchling:创建或更新 DNA、RNA、蛋白等注册实体,管理库存容器与位置、ELN 条目和流程任务,还能查数据仓库、订阅事件。
howto.when: 当你说要对接 Benchling、用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据时接管,例如管理序列实体、库存、ELN 条目。

say.text: 用 benchling-sdk 建一个环状 DNA 序列并注册到实体库
把容器 cont_abc123 转移到 box_xyz789
列出所有 DNA 序列并给出预估总数

howto.what_en: Claude can use the benchling-sdk and v2 API to create and update registry entities (DNA, RNA, protein), manage inventory containers and locations, ELN entries and workflow tasks, and query the Data Warehouse or subscribe to events.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to work with the Benchling SDK or v2 API to automate lab data — e.g. managing sequence entities, inventory, or ELN entries.

say_en.text: Use benchling-sdk to create a circular DNA sequence and register it
List all DNA sequences and give the estimated count
